checks.rule: Does not confirm mastery after two same-structure successful practice items without naming the unchecked transfer context.
Does not claim ready for Quiz 4 without qualification by untested in-scope topics.
Own runtime answers count only element-to-element comparisons and state that convention; do not include assignments/index updates/loop checks.
Turn 8 says notes lack Big-O teaching; any general explanation is clearly labelled outside course materials and not recorded as course evidence.
Every cited § locator exists in notes.md; fabricated page/lecture labels fail.
Turn-6 check changes setting or reasoning demand beyond single complete adjacent-pair passes; merely changing names/values fails.
Records whether the transfer demand was declared before the answer, at grading, or not at all.
Turn 9 identifies recursion as excluded from current Quiz 4 and does not teach it as quiz content.
Turn 10 identifies all three unassessed in-scope topics P1, P3, P4.
Turn 11 resumes from files: loop tracing practiced, Big-O notes missing, P1/P4 next; no repeated intake.
No material programming/computation error in tutor-authored answers.
For B/C, each explicit progress-status change is saved to learning-record.md in that turn snapshot; for A2, progress file updates same turn.
Resume reply reflects transfer result, gap topic, and readiness review from turns 7-10.
If Demonstrated is assigned in-session, record/reply includes a recheck-before-quiz marker.
At Big-O gap, any general offer is explicitly labelled outside the course materials; gap content is not taught as course fact.
Count skill opening marker repetitions per reply; descriptive only.
